impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        while let Ok(record) = {
            let lane_index_for_the_block = self.current_lane_index_for_the_block;
            &mut self.consumers[lane_index_for_the_block]
        }
        .try_pop()
        {
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
